questions.question: Bought a hoodie 9 days ago and changed my mind. Can I still send it back?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, returns are accepted within 14 days of delivery, provided the hoodie is unused and in its original packaging.

questions.question: Do you offer gift wrapping for birthday orders?
I wore the jacket once to a party and now want to return it. Is that okay?
questions.expected_answer: No, to be eligible for a return the item must be unused and in its original packaging.

questions.question: Will my refund go back to the card I paid with?
questions.expected_answer: Refunds are issued to the original payment method.

questions.question: My lamp arrived smashed. Do I have to pay to ship it back, and how do I get my money back?
questions.expected_answer: No, return shipping is not your cost for a damaged item, but please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with a photo. The refund goes to your original payment method and takes 5-7 business days after we receive the item.

questions.question: Ordered a medium but I need a large. Can I exchange it?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, exchanges are allowed for size or color, subject to stock availability.

questions.question: Is there a Northwind store in Toronto I can visit in person?
I don't need it fast. How long does regular shipping take?
questions.expected_answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days.

questions.question: How much is standard shipping?
questions.expected_answer: Standard shipping costs $4.99, and it is free on orders over $50.

questions.question: How fast is express delivery?
questions.expected_answer: Express shipping takes 1-2 business days.

questions.question: My order was $30. How much would express shipping cost me?
questions.expected_answer: Express shipping costs $12.99.

questions.question: I placed my order at 1:45 PM. Will it leave the warehouse today?
questions.expected_answer: Orders placed before 2 PM ship the same business day, so yours should ship today.

questions.question: Will I get an email when my package leaves?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, a tracking number is emailed to you once your order ships.

questions.question: I typed the wrong apartment number. Can I fix it after ordering?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, you can change your shipping address within 2 hours of placing your order.

questions.question: My package is missing. What should I do?
questions.expected_answer: Please contact us to start a lost package claim if the package has not arrived 10 days after the estimated delivery date.

questions.question: Can you deliver to a PO box in Ohio?
questions.expected_answer: No, we cannot ship to PO boxes.

questions.question: Do you take Apple Pay at checkout?
My cart only comes to $25. Will WELCOME10 still work for me?
questions.expected_answer: No, WELCOME10 requires a minimum order of $30.

questions.question: I'm new here. How much off will my first order get with WELCOME10?
questions.expected_answer: New customers get 10% off their first order with WELCOME10.

questions.question: I'm a new customer with a $28 cart. Can I stack WELCOME10 with the friend code I was sent?
questions.expected_answer: No. WELCOME10 requires a $30 minimum order, and only one discount code can be used per order because codes cannot be combined.

questions.question: Can I use two discount codes on the same order?
questions.expected_answer: No, only one discount code can be used per order.

questions.question: I signed up for the newsletter. Do I ever get new codes?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, newsletter subscribers receive a new discount code every month.

questions.question: I got a code last month. Will it still work today?
questions.expected_answer: Discount codes expire 30 days after they are issued.

questions.question: I bought a lamp for $60 and it dropped in price 4 days later. Can I get the difference back?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, if an item's price drops within 7 days of purchase, we will refund the difference on request.

questions.question: Can I use a gift card to buy another gift card for my cousin?
questions.expected_answer: No, gift cards cannot be used to buy other gift cards.

questions.question: The headphones I bought dropped in price 3 days later, and I'm thinking about returning them instead. What are my options?
questions.expected_answer: If the price drops within 7 days of purchase, you can request a refund of the difference. You can also return an unused item in its original packaging within 14 days of delivery.

questions.question: Do I earn loyalty points on my purchases?
They sent me the wrong color. Do I have to pay postage to send it back?
questions.expected_answer: No, return shipping is only your responsibility when the item is not damaged or wrong.

questions.question: The item I received is damaged. How long do I have to tell you?
questions.expected_answer: Please contact us within 48 hours of delivery.

questions.question: I want to swap my green shirt for blue, but blue might be sold out. Is that possible?
questions.expected_answer: Exchanges are subject to stock availability, so the exchange depends on the color being in stock.

questions.question: Do you deliver to Canada?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, we ship to the United States and Canada only.

questions.question: Can I cancel my whole order after I've placed it?
What shipping options do you have?
questions.expected_answer: We offer two shipping options: standard and express.

questions.question: What materials are your tote bags made from?
My tracking email came 3 weeks ago and the package still hasn't shown up, 11 days past the delivery estimate. Can you help?
questions.expected_answer: A tracking number was emailed to you once the order shipped, and since the package has not arrived 10 days after the estimated delivery date, please contact us to start a lost package claim.

questions.question: Once you receive my returned boots, how long until the refund shows up?
questions.expected_answer: Refunds may take 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item.

questions.question: Will I have to pay customs duties on an order shipped to Canada?
Do I need to send proof with my damage report?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, please include a photo when you contact us about a damaged or wrong item.

questions.question: I changed my mind on an unopened item. Who pays for the return label?
questions.expected_answer: The customer pays for return shipping unless the item is damaged or wrong.

questions.question: What's your customer service phone number?
I sent back an unused sweater on day 13 after delivery. When will I get my money?
questions.expected_answer: Returns are accepted within 14 days of delivery, so day 13 is within the window, and the refund takes 5-7 business days after we receive the item.

questions.question: Can I return a sale item?
questions.expected_answer: No, sale items are final sale and cannot be returned.

questions.question: Can I use WELCOME10 on a sale item?
questions.expected_answer: No, discount codes are not valid on sale items.

questions.question: Do I get free shipping on a $45 order?
questions.expected_answer: No, standard shipping is free only on orders over $50, so a $45 order pays $4.99 for standard shipping.

questions.question: Do you ship to the UK?
questions.expected_answer: No, we ship to the United States and Canada only.

questions.question: Do you match competitors' prices if I find something cheaper?
I returned something bought with a code. Which price do I get back?
questions.expected_answer: You get back the amount you actually paid, not the original price.

questions.question: Newsletter subscribers get a new code every month. Mine is 45 days old, is it still good?
questions.expected_answer: No, discount codes expire 30 days after they are issued, so a 45-day-old code has expired. Newsletter subscribers receive a new code every month.

questions.question: Can I return an item after 20 days?
questions.expected_answer: No, returns are accepted only within 14 days of delivery.

questions.question: What's your warranty on electronics?
Is a 7-character password allowed when I sign up for an account?
questions.expected_answer: No, your password must be at least 8 characters long.

questions.question: Can I turn on two-factor login for my Northwind account so a code is texted to me at sign-in?
I want to buy a gift card for $25.50 for my sister. Is that amount possible?
questions.expected_answer: No, gift cards are sold in whole-dollar amounts from $10 to $500, so $25.50 is not available.

questions.question: My order comes to $180 and I'm choosing standard shipping. Will someone have to sign for it, and will I be charged for shipping?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, orders totaling $150 or more need a signature at delivery, and standard shipping is free on orders over $50, so you pay nothing for shipping.

questions.question: One of the items I want says backordered. How long until it comes back in stock, and what if it's still out later?
questions.expected_answer: A backordered item is expected back in 1 to 6 weeks, and if it is still out of stock after 30 days, a new estimated date will be shown.

questions.question: Nobody was home, and the delivery person left a slip instead of my parcel. Why did they do that?
questions.expected_answer: Because a signature was required and no one signed, the carrier left a notice instead of the parcel.

questions.question: Do you offer student discounts if I send a copy of my enrollment letter?
I checked out without making an account. Will that order show up when I log in and look at my history?
questions.expected_answer: No, guest orders do not appear in an account's order history.

questions.question: I pre-ordered a lamp and it arrived cracked yesterday. Can I send it back, and do I have to pay for the return postage?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, a pre-ordered item can be returned once it has been delivered, and since it arrived damaged you don't pay return shipping if you contact us within 48 hours of delivery with a photo.

questions.question: Can I spend the balance of one gift card over a few separate purchases?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, the balance can be spent across several orders until it reaches zero.

questions.question: My pre-ordered speaker's release date just moved back by 45 days. Is that allowed, and will someone tell me?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, the release date can move by up to 60 days after the date first shown, and you will be emailed each time it changes.

questions.question: Which courier company delivers my parcels, UPS or someone else?
Can the carrier drop off my parcel at 9 PM on a weeknight?
questions.expected_answer: No, carriers deliver only between 8 AM and 6 PM local time.

questions.question: The carrier dropped my parcel in a safe place 12 days ago because no signature was needed. Can I still send it back?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, a parcel left in a safe place counts as delivered on the day it was dropped off, so it is still within the 14-day return window, as long as the item is unused and in its original packaging.

questions.question: I'm typing my gift card code and I'm not sure if I need the exact capital letters from the email. Does it matter?
questions.expected_answer: No, gift card codes are not case-sensitive.

questions.question: I want my account deleted for good. What happens to my personal info and my old orders?
questions.expected_answer: Your personal data is removed within 45 days, but we keep your order records for 7 years for accounting purposes.

questions.question: How do I change the email address attached to my account to a new one?
I want to pre-order 5 of the same pair of headphones for my office. Is that allowed?
questions.expected_answer: No, a customer can pre-order up to 2 units of the same item.

questions.question: I lost the email with my gift card code. Can you send it again, and how many times?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, the code can be resent to your email address up to 3 times.

questions.question: I unsubscribed from marketing emails in my account. Will I still get the tracking email when my order ships?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, turning off marketing emails does not stop order and delivery emails, and a tracking number is emailed to you once your order ships.

questions.question: My gift card is from three years ago. Has it expired, and can I cash out what's left?
questions.expected_answer: It has no expiry date, but an unused balance is not paid out in cash.

questions.question: Will I get a heads-up before my pre-order ships?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, you receive a release email 3 days before the item ships.

questions.question: I asked for a password reset 2 hours ago and the link still doesn't work. Is it still valid?
questions.expected_answer: No, a password reset link is valid for 60 minutes only, so a link sent 2 hours ago is no longer valid.

questions.question: Can I pick a two-hour delivery window, like 1 to 3 PM, for my parcel?
The carrier tried yesterday and I wasn't home. Can I ask for another delivery attempt?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, you can request a redelivery within 2 business days of a failed delivery attempt.

questions.question: I bought a $50 gift card two hours ago and the code never arrived. What should have happened?
questions.expected_answer: The code should have been emailed within 15 minutes of purchase to the address you entered at checkout.

questions.question: I pre-ordered a $80 speaker and want to switch to an in-stock one before it ships. When will I be charged?
questions.expected_answer: You can switch to an in-stock item of the same or lower price before it ships, and pre-order items are charged when they ship, not when the order is placed.

questions.question: Is there a paid membership program with extra perks for frequent buyers?
How many gift card codes can I keep saved in my customer account at the same time? I have a bunch.
questions.expected_answer: You can store up to 10 gift card codes in your account at once.

questions.question: I placed an order 2 years and 3 months ago. Will it still show in my order history?
questions.expected_answer: No, order history shows only orders placed in the past 2 years.
